conbody.p: Modern PCs are very easy to put together. Cards slot into their sockets only one way. Power cables also only connect one way. The main hurdles are getting the CPU and heatsink installed, which usually requires applying thermal paste, screwing the base together, and then snapping the fans onto the heat sink in a cramped space, and then arranging the cables such that you can see what you’re doing when inserting RAM and other cards into your motherboard.
